name: MFF International Title
epitaph: Black Bolt, the reigning champion, lost the International Championship to Weapon-X, a mystery special opponent, at Clash of the Champions '99 — the only title change in this belt's own surviving lineage. Dead Pool's own served bio card separately counts one undated past International reign of his own, not structured here for lack of dates.

name: MFF Light Weight Title
epitaph: Night Crawler, the reigning champion, lost the Light Weight Championship to Blizzard at Clash of the Champions '99, aided by a Cannonball run-in — the only title change in this belt's own surviving lineage.

name: MFF World Title
epitaph: Deathlok, the reigning champion, lost the World Championship to Spawn in a special-referee match at Clash of the Champions '99 that ended with the referee, GW Bridge, attacked after the pin — the only title change in this belt's own surviving lineage. Dead Pool's own served bio card separately counts four undated past World reigns of his own, not structured here for lack of dates.

name: MFF Heavy Weight Title
epitaph: Midevil Spawn, already the reigning champion entering Clash of the Champions '99, retained the Heavy Weight Championship against Destroyer — a Robo Destroyer interference set up a Destroyer near-fall before Terrax speared and Tiger Bombed Destroyer, letting Spawn finish the match — the only documented moment in this title's own surviving lineage. Dead Pool's own served bio card separately counts one undated past Heavy Weight reign of his own, not structured here for lack of dates.
